notOptions: Dictation (option in V2, not in MVP/V1)

differences.what: Choose-many. Other asks for a short text.
The text box is the field Chief concern. It goes into the EMS handoff summary.
Titled Chief Concern in the lines; it is its own text box, labelled History of present illness.
Dictation is left out: the text box takes the phone keyboard's own microphone.
Choose-many: several vaccines can be discussed in one visit.
Status is asked once for each vaccine picked: a grid whose rows are the vaccines picked, its cell choose-one.
Given today records no lot number or expiry here: the supply confirmation screen captures them.
Choose-many: several screenings can be done or offered in one visit.

Action is asked once for each screening picked: a grid whose rows are the screenings picked, its cell choose-many. Declined cannot be held with Performed or Ordered, so a declined test deducts no kit; Education and Referred can be held beside it. The row has no Buttons: label.
differences.why: inventory A12, A21, A24; PRD main 431 (the supply mapping fires on the action); focused-exam inventory default 17; PLAN-OPEN (forms 10.1 #1): the pairs, for the clinical team

differences.what: Six numbers, each in the EMS handoff summary. Blood pressure is two whole numbers in mmHg (systolic 0 to 300, diastolic 0 to 200); heart rate 0 to 300 bpm; SpO₂ 0 to 100 %; respiratory rate 0 to 80 breaths/min; temperature 50 to 115 °F with one decimal; pain a whole number out of 10. The lower limits refuse only what cannot be measured: an overdose before naloxone (respiratory rate 2, SpO₂ in the 40s) and hypothermia (heart rate below 20, temperature below 70 °F) are charted as measured.
differences.why: PLAN-OPEN (forms 10.1 #1): units and ranges of the vitals, inventory A10, to confirm with the clinical team; forms 10.1 #6 for the handoff

differences.what: Temperature is in °F only. A10 asks for a °C switch, and a number's second unit is a factor (altUnit perUnit), which °C to °F is not.
differences.why: inventory A10; forms 2.2 (a departure, for the format's owner)

differences.what: ADD VITAL: the Vitals section repeats, up to 10 sets, each an entry of its own; an entry's time is when it was added.
differences.why: inventory A13; forms 2.3; PLAN-OPEN (forms 10.1 #1): the most sets of vitals in one note

differences.what: The ten-button Focused Exam row is not typed here. The exam picker is the section exam of the piece exam-picker, after Vitals, with every system of the Focused Exam.
ADD ANOTHER MODALITY is the picker's [+ Add exam], in the piece exam-picker.
